sentences.text: In January 2026, Powell said the economy was benefiting from the AI buildout of data centers and that AI could have significant effects on the economy, workforce, and society.

He described uncertainty about AI’s overall effect, noting possible short-term job elimination and some connection between low hiring for recent college graduates and AI, though not as the main or only driver.
He also said large companies cite AI when reducing hiring or laying off workers, and that policymakers are watching and learning.
Earlier, in 2025, he said AI could be labor-augmenting or labor-replacing and could raise productivity, while cautioning it was too early to attribute higher productivity mainly to generative AI.
